title: Orange Texture Pack
description: This texture pack known from mc.oranges.lt server and it's custom made for the server, but if you want, here it's updates will show up!
body:
This pack features Orange design to recreate the authentic old-school Minecraft feeling for some things.

## Features:
- Sound scheme that only plays C418's default music on world 
- Old Minecraft visuals (ores, water, and blocks)
- Optimized for performance, visuals

For c418: [license](https://c418.org/2017/01/26/what-am-i-allowed-to-do-with-daniels-music/)

For minecraft [license](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/eula) that you accept by default

**Visit: https://oranges.lt**
